about_short_description.short_description: BeeBettor is a platform that automates and monetizes sports betting strategies.

product.name: BeeBettor +EV Sports Betting Platform
product.description: A platform that automates the building, execution, and tracking of sports betting strategies using expected value calculations and custom sportsbook weightings.

product.name: Expected Value Settings
product.description: A configurable set of filters and parameters to customize expected value betting strategies, including bet sizing and timing.

product.name: BeeBettor Odds Screen
product.description: A tool to compare odds across multiple sportsbooks quickly to identify value bets outside the main EV recommendations.

product.name: BeeBettor Scratchpad
product.description: An interactive tool that enables users to adjust bets on the fly, accounting for odds boosts and custom devigs.

product.name: Expected Value Weightings
product.description: A feature that lets users assign custom weights to sportsbooks based on their perceived sharpness to influence EV calculations.

product.name: Expected Value Betting
product.description: A method of identifying profitable bets by comparing sportsbook odds to true probabilities to find positive expected value opportunities.
